reason.en: Schedule context organization from tool/PTC/compaction events with per-session deduplication; retain information based on future execution needs rather than a fixed threshold alone.

reason.zh: 防守指挥台把事实库、任务队列和授权范围分开约束；外部日志/样本作为不可信数据，改配置前记录回滚值。七个明确不要手选的worker不计独立用户预设。
reason.en: Separate the defensive fact store, queue and authorized scope; treat logs/samples as untrusted data and record rollback values before configuration changes. Seven explicitly non-manual workers are not counted as user presets.

reason.zh: 窄调度器只交自包含任务给不可恢复的外部子代理，区分返回任务id与真正完成通知，等待期间不得重复派单。
reason.en: A narrow dispatcher sends self-contained tasks to non-resumable external workers, distinguishing job IDs from completion notices and preventing duplicate dispatch while waiting.

reason.zh: 清理先只读发现、分风险等级、出manifest，再按明确确认删除；优先回收站，不能把检查或模糊同意当删除授权。
reason.en: Discover read-only, tier risks, and present a manifest before explicitly approved deletion; prefer trash and never treat checks or vague assent as deletion authorization.

reason.zh: 把只读规划与写入实施分别交给不同provider；只分析请求不强派执行，用户明确不要规划时允许直接实施通道。
reason.en: Assign read-only planning and implementation to different providers; do not force execution for analysis-only requests, and allow an explicit user request to skip planning.

reason.zh: 专用provider及作用域同名遮蔽限制唯一执行工具，任务书提前补足范围/禁改项/验收，避免子代理不能追问时靠猜。
reason.en: Use a dedicated provider and scoped shadowing to constrain the execution surface, supplying scope, prohibitions and acceptance up front when workers cannot ask follow-ups.

reason.zh: 把专属绘图工具严格留在drawing预设，先状态自检与查规范tag再让用户确认提示词，不给通用模式平添工具噪声。
reason.en: Keep drawing tools inside the drawing preset, checking environment and canonical tags before confirming prompts, instead of adding tool noise to general modes.

reason.zh: 纯声明式组合降低升级面；文档描述当前事实，不把未经确认的实现偏差写成业务规则，提交推送仍需明确指示。
reason.en: A configuration-only composition narrows upgrade exposure; document current facts without turning unapproved implementation drift into business policy, keeping commits/pushes explicitly authorized.

reason.zh: 将目标/基本点/硬软需求与任务树挂钩，按任务类别读画像而非灌入全部；UI对齐栏样式与正文分离。
reason.en: Bind goals, principles and hard/soft requirements to a task tree, load profiles by task category, and style alignment metadata separately from answer content.

reason.zh: 按大型实施、小型实施、只读分诊，避免每次继续或追问都重开完整流程；用户纠正立即作废旧任务书，门禁按风险分级。
reason.en: Triage large implementation, small implementation and read-only work instead of restarting the whole workflow on follow-ups; invalidate briefs on user correction and grade gates by risk.

reason.zh: 人格投影为原生会话prompt，记忆/平台作为可选独立子插件；配置面板不是另一套聊天运行时。
reason.en: Project the persona into native session prompts while keeping memory/platform adapters optional; a configuration panel need not become another chat runtime.

reason.zh: 经典文本引文先查公开语料逐字核对，再分清历史情境与现代类比，最后给当天可验证动作；核不到不能加引号冒充原文。
reason.en: Verify quotations word-for-word against the corpus, distinguish historical context from modern analogy, and conclude with a testable near-term action; never fabricate quotations.

reason.zh: 声明式四角色委派按阶段传完整任务包与verdict，且明确persona只是治理约定，不是假装自动FSM或权限隔离。
reason.en: Pass complete task packages and verdicts across declarative role stages, explicitly treating persona guidance as governance rather than an automatic FSM or permission boundary.

reason.zh: 持久teammate与一次性subagent工具面在agent创建时加调用guard，硬隔离比仅在persona里要求更可审计。
reason.en: Install invocation guards at agent creation to separate persistent teammate and one-shot subagent surfaces, making isolation more auditable than persona-only instructions.

reason.zh: 按可观测任务规模决定是否规划/委派，独立工作并行、有依赖串行；来源承认这不是所有委派路径的强制隔离。
reason.en: Use observable task size to trigger planning/delegation, parallelize independent work and serialize dependencies; the source admits this does not enforce isolation across every route.

reason.zh: 事实标记文件/检索/记忆三类，记忆必须转成可查来源才能进结论；开工先写可运行完成条件，交叉模型验证按用户要求而非强制扇出。
reason.en: Label file/search/memory facts, upgrading memory to inspectable evidence before conclusions; define executable completion conditions and reserve model cross-checks for user-requested cases.

reason.zh: 可取的通用机制是每个假设带预期证据、失败信号和停止条件，并要求发现落库；内部六个明确不要手选的worker不凑独立配置数。
reason.en: Generalizable mechanisms attach expected evidence, failure signals and stop conditions to hypotheses and persist findings; six explicitly non-manual workers do not inflate independent configuration counts.

reason.zh: 把原先全局桥转成preset子树，工具注册继承scope，未选模式不挂载桥；只研究封装边界，不安装REA或执行其npx载荷。
reason.en: Move a global bridge into a preset subtree so tool registration inherits scope and unselected modes do not mount it; study encapsulation without installing REA or running its npx payload.

reason.zh: 根据运行时委派标记确定root/worker身份，决定留在root、执行在隔离worker；禁止任务结束留下进程，Cordis面另加只读运行时检查能力。
reason.en: Derive root/worker identity from runtime delegation markers, keep decisions at root and execution in fenced workers, prohibit surviving processes, and add read-only runtime inspection only in the Cordis face.
